title: Normalized strict Tate tower data and chart-domain predicates
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell and the ordinary strict coefficient towers and derived tensor operations of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], [def-sp-ell-twist-quotient-data], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [def-sp-tower-shriek-realization]. Define a Tate tower datum on a scheme T to be the existing SpChartAdmissibility.Twists structure: ordinary finite Kummer comparisons, their root-projection normalization, one strict system for each nonnegative Tate exponent, isomorphisms of each ordinary level with the specified finite Tate line, and equality of the actual semilinear transitions with the specified root transition under those isomorphisms. Define tensoring by these degree-zero towers, the separate finite cohomology and Tor bounds, the unnormalized full domain together with bounded-below and finite etale-origin witnesses, the compact-support bounds, the literal chart pullback/twist, and its ordered affine-coordinate stages. These are only data and predicates; no admissibility or existence assertion is made.
